title: STX Skill Catalog Entry
description: Single source of truth for one STX skill's user-facing documentation. Lives at .claude/skills/<name>/catalog.json. Consumed by the generator in .claude/skills/stx-help-html/scripts/generate-help.js, which writes the terminal listing into stx-help/SKILL.md and the HTML cards into stx-help-html/help.html (both regions delimited by BEGIN AUTO / END AUTO markers).

name.description: Folder name under .claude/skills/ — must match the directory this catalog.json lives in.

slash.description: Display name with leading slash, e.g. /stx-feature.

version.description: Must equal the version field of the matching SKILL.md frontmatter. The build's check-docs step verifies this.

zone.description: Where the skill is meant to run. Drives the type chip in HTML cards and the group in the terminal listing.

icon.description: Single uppercase letter shown in the HTML card's left badge.

terminal.description: How this skill is rendered in /stx-help's terminal listing.

group.description: Section header in the /stx-help text. Hidden when zone=planned.

lines.description: One or more terse one-liners shown under the slash name. First line is the summary; subsequent lines are continuation (indented) — typically used for --autonomous notes or planned-status notes.

summary.description: One sentence shown in the collapsed summary row.

paragraph.description: Opening paragraph inside the expanded card body.

use_when.description: Bullets for the green 'Use when' block.

dontuse_when.description: Bullets for the red 'Don't use when' block.

comment.description: Rendered as a # comment above the command.

cmd.description: The invocation. May contain Markdown-style tokens: option text wrapped in <o>...</o>, string args in <s>...</s>.

extras.description: Ordered, optional content blocks rendered after the invocations.

html.description: Raw HTML body of the callout. Trust-checked manually in PR review.
